purpose: Resume-safe production ledger for bilingual, chapter-specific Class 6 Science lesson data. This tracks content authoring only; it does not imply application implementation, source completeness, approval or publication.
non_negotiable_rules: Every authored lesson belongs to exactly one canonical chapter and one topic within that chapter.
No lesson explanation, visual, interaction, example, or practice item may teach concepts from another chapter. Incidental chapter-scope examples must not become mini-lessons on later topics.

English and Hindi are authored as a paired record from the same canonical learning objectives. Preserve identical objective, block, visual, question, answer IDs, grading rules and intended difficulty.

The single global app language selector drives every student-visible string across web and Android; the user can switch it at any time. Do not make the learner select language separately inside each section.

Every learner-visible field needs non-empty en and hi values: lesson metadata, explanation, captions, alt text, diagram labels, activities, practice prompts/options, feedback, hints, answer explanations, rubrics, glossary, recap, and shared UI controls/errors/status labels.

Language changes must switch the whole visible experience together and preserve question index, selected/typed answers, score, progress and reading position. Mixed-language screens and silent cross-language fallback are prohibited.
Every artifact has distinct Explain and Practice sections; practice includes multiple question types.
Generated explanations, diagrams and practice questions are authored learning aids, not verbatim NCERT text or NCERT-provided assessment questions.

V3 source images stay review-only until checked for semantic fit, source fidelity, alt text, provenance, rights and approval. Full-page source previews containing English text are editor-only and must not render as student visuals in Hindi mode.
Generating a lesson does not establish source completeness, fact-checking, bilingual approval or publication eligibility.
After every newly generated topic lesson, commit the lesson JSON first, then immediately update this progress index with the latest commit/path, status and exact next action.
Work on content artifacts only unless UI implementation is separately requested. Preserve existing application data and workflows.

resume_instructions: Read this index first and open the exact lesson artifact recorded above.
Do not regenerate or overwrite completed lesson JSON blindly; inspect it and make additive corrections.
Continue on main; do not create an extra branch for this content-authoring stream.

Apply the single global locale contract to every learner-visible string, including question-type/status labels and shared web/Android UI. The language switch must update all visible content while preserving active learning state; data files specify requirements but do not implement runtime.
For the active topic, resolve Hindi page mapping and source visual/rights gaps; do not display the English source-page preview as a student asset.
Then generate topic 2 with separate Explain and Practice sections and paired en/hi content. Commit it, then update this index immediately.
Do not mark a chapter complete until every topic has source reconciliation, visual mapping, bilingual parity and practice review.
